digest.component_or_area: LLM fallback chain instrumentation and tracing
propositions: Each attempted fallback candidate must emit exactly one OTel span with zero-based order, provider-qualified model identity, and outcome from {raised, returned}, nested as a child under the single Agent model-request span via ambient context, with no duplicate instrumentation from instrument_all.
Candidate span reasons on raised outcomes must be sanitized through sanitize_diagnostic (allowlisted keys only) to redact prompts, responses, credentials, endpoints, and unsanitized exception bodies.

The S2-preserved bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade (two separate agent.run calls) must be legible as a native attempt span raised then a prompted attempt span returned, with no change to _pai_structured control flow.
Span emission and exporter failures while tracing is enabled must be swallowed at the wrapper boundary, leaving fallback result, RunUsage, propagated exception, and _usage identical to tracing-off.
Candidate model wrapping at build_fallback_model must not alter FallbackModel selection predicates, ProviderSession lifecycle, RunUsage, UsageLimits, pricing, JSONL, or candidate_requests counters.
Tracing must remain best-effort with no hard dependency on opentelemetry imports for base install and lean-import execution.
